resolved_findings.finding: Main report could hash an oversized attachment after the bounded dashboard reader refused it.
resolved_findings.resolution: Before attachment reading or Sources.add, require a JSON reference and reject an existing file above the bounded-reader cap. Synthetic reduced-cap test proves the report SHA function is not called.

resolved_findings.finding: Timing exporter canonicalizes the actual trial path while the plan retains the results symlink path; exact string comparison rejects a legitimate saved annex.
resolved_findings.resolution: Permit identical paths or two real absolute directories whose strict resolutions agree, retain a unique formal slot match, and reject a different batch with the same basename. Synthetic canonical-alias regression covers both directions.

Absent annexes remain PENDING_NOT_PROVIDED; an explicitly missing or rejected file has no saved metric summary and remains source-availability bound.
Only bound FORMAL120 plus EXTENSION_FORMAL160 identities can contribute annex summaries; development contexts or a different trial are rejected.

Tick endpoint remains acquisition to control-loop tick-start source_sim, before update/publish; callback causality, publish completion, PX4 receipt/execution, physical wall E2E and worker-wall FPS remain unobserved.
Every original control command remains in known plus UNKNOWN; unknown values remain null, unique indices and original export counts are checked, and quantiles describe only the known subset.
Original 280 statuses, 80 recovery opportunities, missing detector slots, engineering PASS/FAIL and project_acceptance_claimed=false remain unchanged.
